name: manual_aebea8
claim: After git push to GitHub Pages custom domain, always verify raw GitHub first. Wait 5-10 minutes before trusting live output. If raw shows the fix but live doesn't, it's a Cloudflare cache delay — NOT a deploy failure. Do NOT re-edit or re-push based on stale live output. If GitHub Pages hasn't rebuilt, trigger with: git commit --allow-empty -m 'trigger: rebuild' && git push origin master

decisions.notes: Cloudflare edge nodes serve stale HTML for 3-10 minutes even after Purge Everything + Development Mode. Re-editing based on stale output wastes time and risks regressions. Raw GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) is the source of truth.
